providerMode: Local OpenAI-compatible stand-in (provider-standin.mjs) in its own container on this lab's backend network only; fictional paper and known answers; no real provider account or traffic.
browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless, one context per identity at 1440x1000 CSS px

setup.text: administrator API: Contract C-98 with a placeholder primary and a two-Version Word Document that has never been compared.
legal_team_member API: Contract C-99 with a placeholder primary and a two-Version Word Document that has never been compared.

steps.step: Archiving does not stop comparing existing Versions (new pair on an archived Document)
steps.expected: On an archived Document, Compare with previous for a pair that was never compared opens a Comparison that reaches Changes, offers no export, and adds no Version.
steps.actual: Documents -> Actions -> Archive on doc029-archived-admin.docx; with Show archived on, its Actions still offered ["Compare with previous","Restore","Delete"]. Compare with previous opened a first-time v1 → v2 Comparison that reached Changes with no export control; the chain still has 2 Versions. The Document was restored afterwards (API).
